build_resnext3d_model: build a ResNeXt3D model from a config dict using build_model for video classification
test_forward_pass_resnext3d: test the ResNeXt3D model forward pass with video input tensors in train or test mode
test_set_classy_state_plain: test saving and loading a ResNeXt3D model state using get_classy_state and set_classy_state
test_weight_inflation_2d_to_3d: test inflating 2D ResNeXt conv weights to initialize a 3D ResNeXt model via set_classy_state
test_inconsistent_kernel_size_error: test that set_classy_state raises an AssertionError when 2D and 3D model kernel sizes mismatch
